card.name: Start of words split after 'sh'
card.fires_on: The letters 'sh' when they begin a word that has been split into pieces, such as shrank, shaggy, shewing, shied, shrewd, shaman or shunning. It appears in ordinary prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Word-initial sh
modes.description: The 'sh' piece begins a word, and the rest of the word follows in the next piece.
modes.example: The rivers all<< sh>>rank into narrow streamlets.

modes.label: Old spelling shew
modes.description: The 'sh' piece starts the old spelling 'shew' for 'show'.
modes.example: to<< sh>>ew the importance and advantage of ascert

modes.label: Inside a longer word
modes.description: The 'sh' piece sits after a prefix, as in foreshadowed.
modes.example: fo<<resh>>adowed the final sacrifice of Christ.
